features.name: Integration Validator Hook
features.description: API contract validation between frontend and backend. A PostToolUse script marks writes to API-surface paths; a Stop script asks for validation once per turn, however many agents did the writing. Replaces a SubagentStop prompt hook that matched on agent name and so never fired for generically typed subagents.

features.name: React 19 Patterns
features.description: Updates react-expert agent with React 19 patterns including use() hook, Server Components improvements, Actions, and optimistic updates.

features.name: Auto-Format on Write Hook
features.description: Automatically runs Prettier or Biome after file modifications to maintain consistent code formatting.

hooks: ds_file=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$ds_file" ] || exit 0; npx prettier --write "$ds_file" 2>/dev/null || npx biome format --write "$ds_file" 2>/dev/null || true

features.name: Type-Check on Write Hook
features.description: Runs TypeScript type-checking after TypeScript file modifications to catch type errors early.

hooks: ds_file=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$ds_file" ] || exit 0; case "$ds_file" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx tsc --noEmit || { echo "tsc reported type errors" >&2; exit 2; };; esac

features.name: Smoke Test After Implementation Hook
features.description: Automatic smoke test trigger after backend implementation agents complete. Detects when backend endpoints or features are modified and triggers the smoke-test-expert to verify everything works end-to-end.

features.name: Python Ruff Auto-Format Hook
features.description: Automatically runs ruff format and ruff check --fix after Python file modifications to maintain consistent code formatting.

hooks: ds_file=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$ds_file" ] || exit 0; case "$ds_file" in *.py) ruff format "$ds_file" 2>/dev/null; ruff check --fix "$ds_file" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0

features.name: Pytest Smoke Test Hook
features.description: Triggers pytest after Python implementation agents complete to verify the test suite remains green.

promptTemplates.smoke-test-prompt:
Analyze the completed agent work and determine if smoke testing is needed.

CONTEXT: $ARGUMENTS

TRIGGER CRITERIA (respond {ok: false} to continue with smoke-test-expert):
- New REST or GraphQL endpoints implemented
- Bug fixes to existing API handlers or services
- Database schema changes with affected endpoints
- Authentication or authorization logic changes
- New service integrations or external API calls

DO NOT TRIGGER (respond {ok: true} to stop):
- Frontend-only changes (CSS, components, UI)
- Documentation or comment changes only
- Test file changes only (unit tests, integration tests)
- Configuration or environment variable changes only
- Refactoring without behavioral changes

Respond ONLY with valid JSON:
{"ok": false, "reason": "Backend implementation detected: [description]"} to trigger smoke test
{"ok": true} to stop without smoke test
promptTemplates.pytest-smoke-prompt:
Analyze the completed agent work and determine if pytest should be run.

CONTEXT: $ARGUMENTS

TRIGGER CRITERIA (respond {ok: false} to run tests with qa-expert):
- New Python functions, classes, or modules implemented
- Bug fixes to existing Python logic
- Changes to data models or validation rules
- New file generators or parsers implemented
- Changes to business logic in services/ modules

DO NOT TRIGGER (respond {ok: true} to stop):
- Documentation or comment changes only
- Test file changes only
- Configuration or pyproject.toml changes only
- UI/Streamlit layout changes without logic changes
- Dependency updates without code changes

Respond ONLY with valid JSON:
{"ok": false, "reason": "Python implementation detected: [description]"} to trigger pytest
{"ok": true} to stop without running tests
